name: Zepto
description: Search products, manage cart, and place grocery orders on Zepto
author: flock

requires.description: Log in to Zepto via the dashboard browser session to access grocery delivery
requires.rationale: Zepto has no public API — a saved browser session is how the agent shops on your behalf.

browser.setup_instructions: Log in to your Zepto account via the dashboard. Ensure your delivery address is set to the correct location before connecting.

checkout.reason: review opens the cart (up to two browser steps); pay clicks through to the payment page and its UPI option with payment capture on, waiting up to 20s for the payment page. Killed at 30s, the person is left with a half-opened payment page.

list-addresses.reason: Loads the home page, opens the header's address picker and waits up to 8s for its saved addresses.

set-delivery-location.reason: Opens the address picker, reads the saved addresses, clicks the matching one and waits for the page (and a change-address prompt) to settle: three browser steps with waits.

empty-cart.reason: Removes cart lines one at a time (each unit, where only a minus is shown), waiting for the page after each: up to 70s for a full cart.

view-cart.reason: Waits up to 10s for the cart lines or its empty message, then reads the lines and every bill row.
